scope.definition: Public ONS data-asset metadata discoverable through the registered official source lanes at a stated snapshot date.
globalExclusions: Observation values and statistical data cells
Binary dataset downloads and full geometries
Credentials, cookies and request-specific personal information

snapshotPolicy.rawPages: Operational cache only; never published in an OKF bundle.
snapshotPolicy.frozenBuild: Publication consumes content-hashed cached pages without network access.
publicProvenance: response ETag or Last-Modified when supplied

reconciliationSourceLedger.purpose: Planned official metadata lanes used to reconcile identities, releases, quality evidence, time-series codes and catalogue representations across ONS surfaces.
reconciliationSourceLedger.coverageRule: A planned lane does not contribute to a coverage or completeness claim until its acquisition method, denominator, stopping rule, frozen snapshot and unrepresented-record count are implemented and evaluated.
reconciliationSourceLedger.conflictRule: Preserve every material source value and its provenance as conflicted evidence; never silently overwrite one official surface with another.

lanes.title: ONS website dataset search and dataset pages
reconciliationRole: Discover public dataset and download pages not represented by the ONS Data API
Cross-reference website slugs, canonical URLs, titles, editions and download identities
Preserve methodology, quality, related-data and publication links
expectedCrossReferences: dataset family and edition path segments
lanes.denominatorPlan: Measure all unique in-scope dataset results at the frozen snapshot and classify every result as represented, alias, redirect, duplicate representation, tombstone or explained exclusion.
lanes.stoppingRulePlan: Follow the official search pagination to its reported end, then reconcile canonical dataset links and record the final page and record counts.
lanes.publicationBoundary: Metadata and links only; no spreadsheet, CSV or observation payloads.

lanes.title: ONS release calendar and statistical release pages
reconciliationRole: Attach announced, published, revised, cancelled and provisional release context
Distinguish dataset versions from release pages and publication editions
Preserve correction notices, revision explanations and back-series links
lanes.denominatorPlan: For a declared calendar interval, count every release-calendar result and reconcile it to a release record, redirect, duplicate representation or explained exclusion.
lanes.stoppingRulePlan: Use an explicit start and end date, exhaust every result page, and record the interval and upstream result count.
lanes.publicationBoundary: Release metadata and explanatory links only; no statistical values copied from release text.

lanes.title: ONS Quality and Methodology Information

authority.name: Office for National Statistics
authority.role: authoritative producer quality and methodology surface

reconciliationRole: Attach strengths, limitations, methods and quality-dimension evidence
Cross-reference statistical products, dataset series and release pages
Preserve source wording for relevance, accuracy, timeliness, accessibility, coherence and comparability
expectedCrossReferences: related dataset, release and bulletin links
lanes.denominatorPlan: Enumerate unique QMI records reachable from the official QMI collection and in-scope product pages, then reconcile every record or explain its exclusion.
lanes.stoppingRulePlan: Exhaust collection pagination or index groups and close the denominator only after canonical URL de-duplication.
lanes.publicationBoundary: Source-attributed metadata summaries and evidence links; no claim that QMI presence proves statistical accuracy.

lanes.title: ONS time-series pages and identifiers
reconciliationRole: Cross-reference time-series codes to dataset families, editions and releases
Preserve measure, unit, seasonal-adjustment, frequency and version context
Distinguish similarly named series before an MCP selection is generated
lanes.denominatorPlan: Derive the discoverable series-code universe from an official machine-readable index or bounded website enumeration before making a coverage claim.
lanes.stoppingRulePlan: Not yet defined; this lane remains planned until an official bounded enumeration and replayable stopping rule are documented.
lanes.publicationBoundary: Series metadata only; time-series observation values are prohibited.

lanes.title: data.gov.uk records attributed to the Office for National Statistics

authority.name: data.gov.uk
authority.role: official government discovery registry, not the producer source of truth

reconciliationRole: Find legacy, federated or alternative catalogue identifiers and landing pages
Cross-reference publisher, licence, dates, distributions and ONS canonical URLs
Detect stale, redirected or conflicting catalogue representations
lanes.denominatorPlan: Use an official bounded data.gov.uk query constrained to ONS publisher or organisation identity and classify every returned record.
lanes.stoppingRulePlan: Exhaust the official query pagination and record the query, total, page counts, de-duplication and publisher-identity rules.
lanes.publicationBoundary: Registry metadata only; producer evidence takes precedence and conflicts remain visible.

includes: Dataset identities, titles, descriptions, keywords and lifecycle state
Official links to editions, latest versions, taxonomy and dataset records
excludes: Dimension option values in the catalogue pass

includes: Dataset key-family identities, names and catalogue annotations
Dimension, attribute, measure and code-list references

sources.title: ONS Open Geography Portal dataset search
sources.responseFormat: GeoJSON feature collection containing catalogue search records
standards: ONS GSS geography codes and product vintages where supplied

includes: Dataset catalogue identities, titles, descriptions, ownership and timestamps
Keywords, licence statements, item links and catalogue bounding boxes
excludes: Postcode, UPRN and statistical observation rows
